nodes.title: Find booking
nodes.comment: ------------------------------------------------------------------ B. Find the booking. E93: one lookup with no channel filter returns bookings made by phone, WhatsApp, the website and at the branch. E94: the same lookup answers "did I already book?". The booking system matches every filter it is given, so the filters a lookup does not use are cleared before the call, and it refuses a call with no filter at all (ON_FAILURE). It returns bookings from the start of today: one that is still to come, one whose car is at the centre today, and one that was missed today (P13). A reference the caller picked from several bookings must give exactly one booking; if it does not, that counts as a failed pick, so the which-car question stays bounded. ------------------------------------------------------------------

Booking can change = false?
nodes.comment: OPEN Q07 (contact centre): How close to the booked time can a customer still change or cancel it? Until agreed this agent applies no cut-off of its own: a booking is changed or cancelled on the day itself. The booking system is the only judge: when it says the booking can no longer be changed (can_change false here, or the refusal too_late when the change is saved), the call goes to a person (A04). A booking whose answer is missing is treated as changeable, because the booking system still refuses a change it does not allow.

nodes.title: Late fee aed > 0?
nodes.comment: Same rule as E75: a chauffeur pick-up cancelled late carries a fee. The amount comes from the booking system, never from this file.

cases.when: Books any service: pick-up and drop-off
cases.agent_does: Offers pick-up and drop-off on every booking call and adds it to the booking if accepted, with any current free collection offer. A chauffeur pick-up cancelled less than 60 minutes before: cancels it and says the AED 15 fee applies.
cases.open_question: When a customer accepts pick-up and drop-off, does the contact centre agent book the chauffeur or AFL job during the call?

nodes.title: Step outcome = confirmed and contact mobile known?
Step outcome = other number and new contact mobile known?
Step outcome = safety or step outcome = person or step outcome …?
nodes.comment: An answer about the message that cannot be used never undoes or escalates the change: no message is sent and the caller is told so. "Leave it" at this point is about the message, not the booking, which may just have been changed, so it also ends here.

nodes.title: Message language = en or message language = ar?
nodes.comment: The message goes out in the language of the call. Only the two languages it exists in are passed on; anything else is left out and the notify service uses its own default.

nodes.title: Send confirmation
nodes.comment: Same rule as Q08: the first send leaves the channel to the notify service. When it reports that the message did not go out and the channel it used was WhatsApp, the message is sent once more by SMS.

nodes.comment: The read-back is the backup when the message does not go out; it can be sent again.

nodes.title: Step outcome = safety?
nodes.comment: ------------------------------------------------------------------ K. Outcomes any reasoning step can raise: safety, a person, a manager, an upset caller, a booking in someone else's name, a change of mind, keep it. Every step's own branches come first; whatever they do not match lands here, and an outcome nobody listed ends with a person. ------------------------------------------------------------------

nodes.title: Step outcome = manager?
nodes.comment: Same rule as A03 (owned by the handover agent): a caller who asks for a manager keeps that reason, so that the handover agent arranges a manager callback and never a transfer to another contact centre agent.

cases.when: Needs a hold or a transfer
cases.agent_does: Asked for a manager: arranges a manager callback, not a transfer to another contact centre agent. Asked for a person: transfers.

nodes.title: Step outcome = other name?
nodes.comment: OPEN E95 (contact centre): see owner_gate.

cases.when: The booking is in someone else’s name
cases.agent_does: Passes the call to a person, until we agree who can change someone else’s booking.
cases.open_question: Can someone who booked for the owner also change or cancel that booking, or only the owner?

nodes.title: Step outcome = switch and switch action known?
Step outcome = keep or step outcome = stop?
nodes.comment: E98: the caller would rather leave the booking as it is. Before a booking has been found there is nothing to keep: a caller who no longer wants to go on gets a short close, not a hand-over to a person.

cases.agent_does: Keeps the current booking.

nodes.title: Booking open = true?
nodes.comment: A change of mind before a booking was found simply carries on with the lookup. It counts against the same limit as "I mean a different booking", so it cannot loop. "Leave it" before a booking was found ends the task with a short close.

nodes.say: I'm sorry, I'm having trouble with that just now.

nodes.say: This booking is in someone else's name, so I can't handle it myself.

nodes.say: I'm sorry, I couldn't get the plate number right.

nodes.detail: That is a change I can't make myself.
nodes.say: That is a change I can't make myself.

nodes.say: Because the booking is today, I can't change or cancel it myself.

nodes.title: Escape too late
nodes.detail: I'm sorry, I can no longer change or cancel this booking myself.
nodes.say: I'm sorry, I can no longer change or cancel this booking myself.
nodes.comment: OPEN Q07 (contact centre): see change_allowed_gate. The booking system says the booking can no longer be changed or cancelled: before a change is tried (can_change false), or when it is saved (too_late). Nothing was changed. A04: a person.

cases.agent_does: Changes bookings in the booking system itself, not CEM. Any change it can’t make goes to a person.

nodes.detail: I wasn't able to make that change. Your current booking has not been changed.
nodes.say: I wasn't able to make that change. Your current booking has not been changed.
nodes.comment: A04: the booking system would not take the change, or the slot was lost twice. Nothing was changed. The reason code the booking system gave, when it gave one, is passed on.

cases.agent_does: Changes bookings in the booking system itself, not CEM. Any change it can’t make goes to a person.

nodes.say: Something went wrong while I was saving that, so I can't be sure it went through.

nodes.say: I wasn't able to cancel the booking myself. It has not been cancelled.

nodes.title: Escape centre pickup
nodes.detail: This booking includes pick-up and drop-off, which that centre doesn't offer, so moving it needs one of our team.
nodes.say: This booking includes pick-up and drop-off, which that centre doesn't offer, so moving it needs one of our team.
nodes.comment: E97: see centre_pickup_check.

cases.agent_does: Replaces the booking with a new one.

nodes.title: Escape centre not ready
nodes.detail: I wasn't able to make that change. Your current booking has not been changed.
nodes.say: I wasn't able to make that change. Your current booking has not been changed.

nodes.title: Escape move unknown
nodes.detail: Something went wrong while I was moving your booking to {{target_centre_name}}, so I can't be sure it went through.
nodes.say: Something went wrong while I was moving your booking to {{target_centre_name}}, so I can't be sure it went through.
nodes.comment: E97: the booking system gave an error while the booking was being replaced, so it is not known whether the change went through. The replacement is one transaction: either the old booking still stands or the new one is in its place. Nothing is tried again here (same rule as N01: never book twice): the caller is told plainly and the person checks first.

cases.agent_does: Replaces the booking with a new one.

cases.when: The booking fails or shows an error
cases.agent_does: Checks whether the booking went through before trying again, so it never books twice. Still failing: passes the call to a person.

nodes.title: Hand to person now
nodes.comment: The escape itself: the flag is set and the hand-off is made in this one step.

cases.when: Needs a hold or a transfer
cases.agent_does: Asked for a manager: arranges a manager callback, not a transfer to another contact centre agent. Asked for a person: transfers.
Acknowledges it, then passes the call to a person, with a summary.

nodes.title: Booking open = true and concern note known?
nodes.comment: Task finished. Same rule as E69: a concern about a car that is safe to drive is kept as a note for the centre, so a note that no change carried is appended to the booking here. The append changes nothing the caller has to agree to; the fixed step opens the write gate.

cases.when: Adds a concern, like a brake noise, and the car is safe to drive
cases.agent_does: Sends it in the booking notes for the centre.

nodes.title: Closing
nodes.detail: Is there anything else I can help you with?
nodes.say: Is there anything else I can help you with?
nodes.comment: Same rule as E22 (one need, then the next): this agent closes its own turn and the supervisor adds nothing after the return. Every path that reaches this step has just told the caller the outcome in a statement, so the shared closing question follows it once. Only the front desk says goodbye.

cases.agent_does: Handles one, then asks about the next.
